prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A cinematic nighttime office scene set in a modern high-rise, illuminated by the soft, moody glow of desk lamps and the ambient blue light from large windows revealing a city skyline dotted with warm, out-of-focus lights. Three young professionals, all dressed in crisp white shirts, are absorbed in their work at a large wooden desk. The central figure, seen from behind and in profile, types intently on a laptop, the screen casting a cool light on his focused face. To his right, another person reads a book, their expression serious and contemplative, while a third figure, partially obscured in the background, works quietly at a separate desk. A fourth person, blurred in motion, enters the room from the right, adding a sense of life and narrative to the composition. The color palette is dominated by deep blues, soft yellows, and muted earth tones, creating a contemplative, almost melancholic atmosphere. The camera angle is slightly elevated and off-center, with a shallow depth of field that draws attention to the main subjects while allowing the background to softly recede. The overall style is reminiscent of a modern drama film, with careful attention to lighting, mood, and the subtle interplay of isolation and connection among the characters.
